note: Every place on a flag page where one era does not meet the next, and every era with no id or no image. A new one fails the build until it has a verdict; `unreviewed` is the honest default and the count is printed on every build. See scripts/flag_seams.py.

verdicts.unreviewed: Nobody has looked at this seam yet.
verdicts.concurrent: Two polities existed at once and both are listed.
verdicts.unrecorded: No flag evidence exists for the interval; it is left empty on purpose.
verdicts.dating: The two dates conflict; one of them is a mistake to fix.
